# Service Request: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-07 · code b47b7bb71e75 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Post a bounty and get help from a neighbour: leaves, snow, junk, moving and 40 other jobs from $20. Pay in cash or Interac e-Transfer, with a quality bonus.
**Live:** https://service-request.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/service-request · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/servicerequest/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py servicerequest` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Native Forms since 2026-11-07** (branch `forms`, folder `service-request-forms`). The old JavaScript-template source
  (`C:\Users\arkvi\Documents\CLAUDE\service-request`, `web/pages/*.html` + `tools/deploy.py`) must be retired when this is
  merged, or a deploy from there overwrites master with the old version.
- **Money and bonus rules live on the server only** (`Bounties._amounts`, `Work.apply_validation`, `Work.mark_paid`). The
  pages only preview them: `sr.quality(k, n)` = `int(round(100*k/n))` and `sr.need(n, bar)` use the server's own rounding
  (the JS version used Math.round and `ceil(n*bar/100)`, which could differ by one point / one item at exact halves).
  Every shown amount after validation is `amount_due` from the server.
- **Engines stay JavaScript** in `theme/assets/sr-engine.js`: Leaflet maps (loaded lazily from unpkg; `Components/Map`
  mounts on show, destroys on hide), Nominatim search / reverse lookup (only on a tap), "use my location", photo shrinking
  + upload (`Components/Uploader`: the engine calls a Python callback that does `upload_photo` and returns JSON text),
  confetti, CSV download and the landing page's drawn neighbourhood map. Engine replies to Python are JSON text (`sr.plain`).
- **The bounty page** (`Pages/Bounty`) holds every role x status variant: `_action(r, s)` hides all side-panel pieces and
  shows the ones for this stage (same texts and order as the old `action()`), `_main()` toggles the sections, `_pay_panel()`
  is the poster's payment box. Actions go through `_act()` (state.call -> toast -> reload). Dialogs: `Dialogs/Ask` (cancel,
  back out, dispute, raise, admin reject; `run(values)` keeps server errors inside the dialog), `Dialogs/Report`, `SpotPicker`.
- The brand's small pieces (tear-off tag, status stamp, task tile, stars, quality meter, rating) are drawn by
  `sr.fill_*` into `anvil:dom-node`s, not components. Values are always passed through `sr.esc` before `sr.rich`.
- Browser storage keys are unchanged (`servicerequest.theme`, `servicerequest.board.f`, `servicerequest.cheer.<id>`), read
  with `sr.stored` (real dicts, not JS proxies).
- `window.srCall(name, argsJson)` (startup.py) = the same server calls pages make; tools/ui/smoke.js uses it to post a
  bounty and open the poster's view. First account with arkulinskis@gmail.com becomes admin (Accounts.ADMIN_EMAILS).
- `theme/assets/app.css` was generated once from the JS version's CSS (selectors widened to Anvil roles, design-kit fixes,
  hazard stripes kept with `design-ok`); edit it directly from now on. Ledger and the rules page's task table are div
  grids (RepeatingPanel rows), not tables.
- Server code is unchanged apart from type annotations the validator asked for (`changes: dict`, `fields: dict`,
  `rows: list`, `row: dict`, `getattr(anvil.server, "session")`).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
